questions.q: Who created Shaktimaan and also played the hero?
questions.why: Mukesh Khanna produced the show and played both Shaktimaan and his alter ego.

questions.q: Which actor plays the wise Mahaguru who guides Shaktimaan?
questions.why: Tom Alter appears as the Mahaguru, who explains that Kilvish only falls once evil is gone.

questions.q: In which year did the original Shaktimaan series begin?
In which year did the original Shaktimaan series end?
questions.why: The final episode aired on 27 March 2005.

questions.q: What is the job of the hero's secret identity, Pandit Gangadhar?
questions.why: Gangadhar's day job is newspaper photography at Aaj Ki Awaaz.

questions.q: Which journalist gives the hero the name Shaktimaan?
questions.why: The journalist Geeta Vishwas is the one who names the hero Shaktimaan.

questions.q: Who first played the show's journalist heroine before Vaishnavi Mahant took over?
questions.why: Kitu Gidwani played Geeta initially, and Vaishnavi Mahant took over later.

questions.q: On which channel did Shaktimaan: The Animated Series premiere in 2011?
questions.why: Reliance Animation's version began on Sonic on 20 December 2011.

questions.q: The creator said his hero was inspired by which Hollywood superhero?
questions.why: Khanna said the character drew on Superman.

questions.q: Which biscuit brand sponsored Shaktimaan from its first episode?
questions.why: Parle-G backed the show from the start.
